title: The Life Of Pablo [Alternate Cover]
description: Original cover art revealed for The Life Of Pablo. The image on the bottom left corner was taken at Kanye's parents' wedding. This photo is significant, as Ye has a deep feeling of affection and love for his family, which is a pivotal theme throughout the album. The chaotic text may have been inspired by The Shining. One scene in the film shows Wendy Torrance discovering the main antagonist's stack of obsessively typed pages, all repeating the same sentence: "All work and no play makes Jack a dull boy." Also used for the clean release.
people: Joe Perez, Mark Seekings & Peter De Potter

title: YEEZY 350 CLEAT
description: The Yeezy 350 Cleat ‘Turtle Dove’ was first seen on the feet of Houston Texans Wide Receiver DeAndre Hopkins during week one of the 2016 NFL season. Released in September 2016, the cleat sold out by midday. The day after its release, the NFL fined Hopkins $6,000 for wearing the shoes and banned them due to them not having one dominant base color.

title: YEEZY BOOST 350 V2 KIDS
description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Kids ‘Ash Pearl’ shows off split color blocking on a sock-like upper constructed from breathable Primeknit. The top-down view reveals a visible seam that runs down the vamp, separating varying tan and grey shades on the lateral and medial sides. The former is accented with a monofilament side stripe, which gives way to more grey tones on the lower portion of the shoe. Decorated with no-tie elastic laces, the upper is mounted atop full-length Boost midsole.
